events.text: Goal achieved: Map Mars from orbit
Operations funding review: Stable operations funding gives the imaging team better support.
Busy week on the dishes: Partner dishes improve support for the lander's difficult relay windows.
Valve glitch in cruise: The engine supplier's prompt support improves the cruise team's readiness for valve trouble.
Noise in the instrument data: University calibration support improves confidence in the instrument data.
Mars orbit insertion: The moved launch left less rehearsal time and more uncertainty about Mars orbit insertion.
